method: Brown's method for dependent p-value combination
reference: Brown (1975) Biometrics 31:987-992; Poole et al. (2016) Bioinformatics 32:i430-i436

fisher_independent.note: Assumes full independence; likely too liberal

browns_conservative.justification: European streams share blocking; cross-Atlantic correlation is weak

browns_ultra_conservative.justification: Extreme dependence well beyond published SSW teleconnection correlations

conclusion: Even under ultra-conservative dependence (rho=0.7 European, 0.4 cross-Atlantic), the null hypothesis of no systematic snow/avalanche response to SSW weather is rejected at P = 3.66e-06. The two-stream same-direction sensitivity (Swiss + French only, rho=0.7) gives P = 1.27e-03.
